result.effect: larger screen inferiority effect when time is limited

cells.quote: Regarding time frame, meta-analytic evidence shows that the screen inferiority effect increases when time to complete the reading assignment is limited (Delgado et al., 2018).
cells.note: The study text attributes the synthesis to prior meta-analytic evidence; no numerical effect size is reported in the quoted finding.

O.outcome_detail: reading comprehension on tablets versus print

cells.quote: On the contrary, recent empirical studies that have systematically varied the time frame while comparing readers’ comprehension on tablets and in print resulted in null effects (Delgado & Salmerón, 2022; Salmerón et al., 2021).
cells.note: The text does not report randomization, statistical power, equivalence testing, or a numerical effect size; therefore the null finding is coded ns rather than 0.
